title: An FPGA-Based Spiking Neural Network for Spatiotemporal Pattern Learning and Classification
abstract: arXiv:2610.17463v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) are promising for energy-efficient spatiotemporal pattern recognition at the edge, but efficient deployment and on-device adaptation require specialized hardware. In this work, we present an FPGA implementation of multilayer SNNs for spatiotemporal pattern classification, in which both inference and training take place on the same hardware. Our design adopts a temporal-forward-only training algorithm that avoids the memory and latency overhead associated with traditional Backpropagation Through Time (BPTT). A mixed-precision scheme balances training stability with resource efficiency, and architectural optimization maximizes hardware and memory utilization. We further identify and resolve hazards that arise when inference and learning share the same memory, including port conflicts between the forward and backward access patterns and read-after-write dependencies in floating-point potential accumulation. translated_title: 一种基于FPGA的脉冲神经网络用于时空模式学习与分类
translated_abstract: 脉冲神经网络（SNNs）在边缘侧的节能时空模式识别中极具前景，但高效的部署和设备端自适应需要专用硬件。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种用于时空模式分类的多层脉冲神经网络的FPGA实现，其中推理和训练均在同一硬件上进行。我们的设计采用了一种仅前向传播的时间训练算法，避免了传统时间反向传播（BPTT）所带来的内存和延迟开销。混合精度方案在训练稳定性与资源效率之间取得了平衡，架构优化则最大化了硬件和内存的利用率。我们进一步识别并解决了推理和学习共享同一内存时产生的隐患，包括前向与后向访问模式之间的端口冲突，以及浮点电位累积中的写后读依赖问题。
tldr: 本文提出了一种在单一FPGA硬件上同时完成推理与训练的多层脉冲神经网络实现，采用仅前向传播的时间训练算法避免了传统BPTT的内存和延迟开销，并通过混合精度和架构优化解决了推理与学习共享内存时的冲突问题。
